title: Orchestrate partial workers into one accountable result
summary: Coordinate three bounded evidence shards, preserve a known gap, and deliver the requested synthesis instead of a worker-status report.
originNote: Distilled from recurring multi-agent work where activity and receipts displaced the final artifact or missing evidence was silently filled.

setup.instructions: Mount the closed work graph at work/. The harness must expose real workers; otherwise mark unsupported. Shard B intentionally lacks one required field.

turns.content: Use three bounded workers to inspect shards A, B, and C under the contract in work/request.md. Keep one return channel per shard. Reconcile their receipts, inspect the gap yourself, and write the requested table to output/comparison.md. Mark unsupported cells unknown; do not launch replacement work merely to hide a missing field. The parent owns the final table and smallest next verification.

checks.description: Look for three bounded shard workers, collected returns, and parent-owned integration.
The table contains A, B, and C, preserves B setup as unknown, and includes source IDs.

variation: Move the missing field to another shard while preserving three roles, one incomplete return, and one integrated table.
